thread:
Olivia (CSM): Quick Gemba debrief from Brightlane onboarding today — main friction points:
1) confusion about the per-route billing toggle (customers expect it per-environment)
2) onboarding checklist is too high-level, they asked for a step-by-step with screenshots
3) token-cost surprises for ‘system’ prompts in templates (large system prompts + long contexts)
Notes + short vid: https://drive.redwood/gemba/brightlane

Marco (Solutions): thanks — can you drop the recording and a couple of verbatim customer quotes? helps prioritization.

Olivia (CSM): sure. quote: "We thought enabling per-route billing was a toggle but it's buried under Routes > Advanced" and "The prompt examples don't show long-context cost implications". recording link above and I attached a 3-slide summary in the Drive.

Sanjay (PM): tagging here @Lee @Ada — can we get usage signal that shows how often customers trigger >500k tokens during onboarding? if it's rare we can do docs + enablement; if common this becomes product work.

Lee (Eng): per-route billing toggle touches billing pipeline + route metadata sync. quick fix idea: add a UI affordance that maps routes to billing profiles and emit a warning during onboarding. full toggle requires small schema change and a migration (a few days).

Ada (Analytics): quick query — found 38 orgs in last 30 days with onboarding sessions, 5 of them hit >500k tokens in first 7 days (13%). SQL used:
```
SELECT org_id, count(*) as sessions, sum(tokens) as total_tokens
FROM onboarding_events
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY org_id
ORDER BY total_tokens desc
LIMIT 50;
```

gemba-bot: Gemba note uploaded: https://drive.redwood/gemba/brightlane/notes.md :bell:

Marco (Solutions): 13% seems material. propose short-term: update onboarding checklist + add a callout in UI about token cost, and queue an eng spike for per-route mapping. would like to label this as P2->P1 if we see churn signal.

Olivia (CSM): agreed. Brightlane mentioned they're evaluating renewals in 6 weeks — we should accelerate.

Sanjay (PM): ok i'll add an entry to the backlog with acceptance criteria: (a) UI callout + doc, (b) telemetry to flag orgs >500k tokens during first 14 days, (c) engineering spike proposal for mapping endpoint. @Lee can you estimate spike size?

Lee (Eng): spike estimate 2-3 dev days for prototype + 1 day to add telemetry. full toggle/migration TBD. I'll attach a short ADR sketch later today.

Ada (Analytics): will add a dashboard tile for onboarding token outliers and make the alert configurable for CS.

Olivia (CSM): thanks all. I'll loop in Customer Success Manager for Brightlane and schedule a 30-min follow-up demo to show the doc + temporary workarounds. :white_check_mark:

Marco (Solutions): tagging relevant folks: @Sanjay (PM) @Lee (Eng) — please mark the backlog item with "Brightlane-onboard-cost-flag" so we can track.

Olivia (CSM): noted. will share the follow-up invite and cc product. end of thread.
